problem: M2-P2's frozen terminal is CANNOT_CHECK_NO_ADMITTING_WORLD, and the C2 benefit that survived #411 (the history-mined library, served guided-first, beats RESET) has been measured on one author model's worlds only (claude-fable-5-1 model proxy). This study asks whether it holds on worlds from a second author model, with the spec, gates and grammar unchanged.

bound_to.entry_gate_orchestrator: research/m2-traversal-capital-v1/m2p2/m2p2_check.py (unchanged; taxonomy hostile, determinism, floors, compile, G1/G2/G3, viability floor, G-SURF)

runner.note: the controller_v5 runner bb9f219e plus the PARENT_GF/GFQ arms only (#408 registration, #411 records)

bound_to.lifecycle: exactly m2p2_ocm5.sbatch: fresh dev phase per world (slots 200000), checkpoint, OS-process restart, one arm per process, ladder [200000], every success externally verified by checker C

author_unit.definition: a FRESH model session (nested agent, general-purpose, no inherited conversation context) running claude-haiku-4-5, given ONLY the frozen spec verbatim plus instructions to write into a scratch studio directory outside this repository
author_unit.differs_from_m2p2_author: model (claude-haiku-4-5 vs claude-fable-5-1); spec, isolation, must_not_receive, floors and determinism rule identical to M2P2_FREEZE_V1.author_unit
author_unit.must_not_receive: M2P2_FREEZE_V1.author_unit.must_not_receive, plus: any M2-P2 world, chunk set, author note or result
author_unit.independence_limit: same model family (Anthropic Claude), same host and harness; independence is model- and session-level, not family-level. Recorded in not_claimed.

arms.PARENT_GF_D4: PRIMARY ARM. The MDL library mined in the dev phase, served guided-first at fixed depth 4, always live, no rule, no liveness, plain-baseline fallback on a miss. Fixed before any M2-P3 world exists (#411: the non-oracle parent). If the dev phase records no MDL library the arm equals RESET by mechanism
arms.SHUFFLED_HISTORY: control, hardened as m2p1_runner.arm_method (true chunks excluded)

statistics.per_world_primary: EFFECT-SIZE TEST. Per viable world, H0: mean(PARENT_GF_D4) >= 0.5 x mean(RESET) on the same protected targets; one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on d_t = GF_t - 0.5 x RESET_t, 10000 permutations, seed 20260912. A world passes iff its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, i.e. PARENT_GF_D4 is significantly at least 50 % below RESET
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across viable worlds, family-wise alpha 0.05
statistics.precondition: PARENT_GF_D4 < RESET (same test with d_t = GF_t - RESET_t) is reported per world. On hidden-chunk worlds it cannot fail by construction, so it is NOT the terminal; a failure is investigated as an ASSAY_DEFECT signal
statistics.graded_report: k / n viable worlds passing the 50 % bar, always reported whatever the terminal
statistics.why_the_fraction_bar_alone_does_no_work: with significance as the per-world criterion every hidden-chunk world clears it; the falsifier is the 50 % effect-size threshold, and the 80 % fraction only aggregates it

terminals.precedence: ASSAY_DEFECT > AUTHORSHIP_CONTAMINATED > CANNOT_CHECK_TOO_FEW_VIABLE_WORLDS (< 4 viable) > C2_REPLICATED_SECOND_AUTHOR_MODEL | C2_NOT_REPLICATED
terminals.C2_REPLICATED_SECOND_AUTHOR_MODEL: at least 4 viable worlds, and PARENT_GF_D4 passes the 50 % effect-size test (Holm) on at least 80 % of them
terminals.C2_NOT_REPLICATED: at least 4 viable worlds, and PARENT_GF_D4 passes the 50 % effect-size test on fewer than 80 % of them (the falsifier)
terminals.ASSAY_DEFECT: pid_changed false anywhere, checker C disagreement, dev-state tamper, non-deterministic emit, any arm failing to verify a target it reports
terminals.AUTHORSHIP_CONTAMINATED: any taxonomy-disjointness alarm, or any change to the spec, this freeze, the gates, the arms or the statistics after the author session begins

secondary.frozen_m2p2_terminal: M2-P2's frozen arm family and terminal precedence applied unchanged to the M2-P3 worlds via m2p2/stage3/m2p2_stage3.py; expected CANNOT_CHECK_NO_ADMITTING_WORLD; reported, never primary
secondary.target_3_descriptive: CONTINUED_OCM vs PARENT_GF_D4 per world; target (3) stays FALSIFIED unless a separate prospective registration says otherwise

why_not_tuned: PARENT_GF_D4 (MDL, depth 4) was fixed as the single non-oracle parent on M2-P2's eight worlds in #411. The 50 % bar is the level at which the M2-P2 worlds separate from a no-structure outcome with room to fail: M2-P2's point estimates run −59.9 … −94.7 %, one world (hc08) within 10 points of the bar. Calibrated before freezing on M2-P2's existing records under this exact test (LUNARC 3599978, records/m2p3_calibration.log): 7 / 8 worlds pass (87.5 %); hc08 (−59.9 % point estimate) fails the 50 % bar at Holm p = 0.157; every world passes the precondition (p = 0.0001). One more failing world in eight would fall under the 80 % bar, so the falsifier can fire on a comparable authoring. The bar and the ±8-point band are fixed before any M2-P3 world exists; the primary is prospective.
claim_ceiling: C2 replication (history-induced search capital) on worlds from a second author model of the same family
not_claimed: OCM-specific superiority over the strongest parent (target (3) stays FALSIFIED)
an author of a different model family, or human authorship
any change to #323, #277 or #165, which stay open
forbidden: any post-freeze revision of spec, freeze, gates, arms, statistics or terminals (recorded as AUTHORSHIP_CONTAMINATED, never amended)
editing authored artifacts after the author session
using author intent or surface fields in compilation, gating or scoring
scored execution on the Mac mini

independence_report.placement: reported NEXT TO the primary terminal, not as a secondary
independence_report.content: reported, never gating: number of M2-P3 world shapes (chunk count, chunk-length multiset, min builder length, part fractions) equal to an M2-P2 shape; number of identical chunk sets; per-world Jaccard of chunk sets against the nearest M2-P2 world
independence_report.reading: the study can conclude only that the C2 benefit is not an artifact of one model's authoring habits; if M2-P3 shapes or chunk sets collide heavily with M2-P2's, that conclusion is correspondingly weak, and the terminal line says so

co_registered_prediction.clause: POINT PREDICTION: the median over viable worlds of (PARENT_GF_D4 / RESET − 1) is −88 % ± 8 percentage points (M2-P2 median −87.7 %). A median outside [−96 %, −80 %] is recorded as a missed prediction.
co_registered_prediction.placement: reported beside the primary terminal; it does not change the terminal, but a miss is recorded as a missed prediction, not absorbed
co_registered_prediction.why: the median is the sharper instrument: 80 % of worlds can clear the 50 % bar while the median lands far from −88 %, and that outcome must be visible
